summary: Daily agent/agent-infra sweep: JetBrains and OpenAI product deltas, Cloudflare DDoS report, SpaceXAI Grok Bot chatter, plus multiple infra repos (ai-jail, nirvana-os) and a user-facing Claude Code leak report.

candidates.title: JetBrains: The “LSP Moment” for AI Agents — WebStorm ACP
candidates.why_it_matters: WebStorm adds agent-facing LSP/ACP integration enabling agents to interact with IDE/browser workflows.
candidates.next_check: Watch JetBrains release notes and Copilot/IDE integrations for rollout details and security docs.

candidates.title: OpenAI: Daybreak models now available on AWS
candidates.why_it_matters: Daybreak models added to AWS marketplace changes where teams can deploy lower-latency models.
candidates.next_check: Confirm AWS marketplace pricing/regions and integration docs for infra teams.

candidates.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report H1 2026: 1 Tbps attacks rising
candidates.why_it_matters: DDoS intensity and DNS flood trends increase infrastructure risk for agent-hosted services.
candidates.next_check: Check operator guidance for agent-hosted endpoints and Cloudflare mitigations for agents.

candidates.title: SpaceXAI / Cursor: Grok Bot launch for multi-agent collaboration
candidates.why_it_matters: New multi-agent 'Grok Bot' positioning to compete with OpenAI/Anthropic on agent workflows.
candidates.next_check: Look for official SpaceXAI/Cursor blogpost or product page and early user reports on reliability/cost.

candidates.title: akitaonrails/ai-jail: Multi-OS sandbox for running AI agents
candidates.why_it_matters: Provides a local multi-OS sandbox to constrain agents; useful for containment testing.
candidates.next_check: Need independent reports or release notes verifying security properties and adoption.

candidates.title: mem0: Python & Node SDK updates (memory SDK releases)
candidates.why_it_matters: Memory SDK updates improve agent memory primitives and APIs for persistent recall.
candidates.next_check: Track SDK changelog for breaking changes and integration notes for major agent runtimes.

candidates.title: Claude Code leaking real email as User-Agent in curl (privacy leak)
candidates.why_it_matters: Operator detail: toolkit emits real email in User-Agent header, leaking identity in curl examples.
candidates.next_check: Follow Anthropic issue thread for patch and guidance; verify whether other SDKs leak similar headers.
